mode.title: Mode
mode.description: oneWay = cheapest one-way fares from the origin (leave destinations empty to explore everywhere). roundTrip = cheapest return fares with a trip-duration filter. cheapestPerDay = a price calendar for one route across a month.

origin.title: Origin airport (IATA)
origin.description: 3-letter departure airport code, e.g. DUB (Dublin), STN (London Stansted), BER (Berlin).

destinations.title: Destination airports (IATA, optional)
destinations.description: One or more 3-letter arrival codes, e.g. STN, BCN. Leave empty in oneWay/roundTrip to explore all destinations. cheapestPerDay needs exactly one.

departFrom.title: Outbound date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
departFrom.description: Earliest outbound date. Defaults to today.

departTo.title: Outbound date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
departTo.description: Latest outbound date. Defaults to 30 days out.

returnFrom.title: Return date from (round-trip)
returnFrom.description: Earliest inbound date for round-trip mode.

returnTo.title: Return date to (round-trip)
returnTo.description: Latest inbound date for round-trip mode.

month.title: Month (YYYY-MM, price calendar)
month.description: The month to price for cheapestPerDay mode, e.g. 2026-08. Defaults to the outbound-from month or this month.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR, GBP, PLN.

maxPrice.title: Max price (optional)
maxPrice.description: Only return fares at or below this price (in the chosen currency). 0 = no cap.

maxRows.title: Max fare rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on fare rows returned. Controls total cost.
